category.name: Time tracking
category.description: Track work hours by client and project, analyze timesheets, and prepare billable work.
category.audience: Freelancers, agencies, consultants, and teams recording project or billable hours.
category.audienceRationale: Relevant across professional services and project-driven teams; recording work hours is a recurring need across industries.

pricing.note: Starter USD9/user/month billed annually; USD12 monthly. Free plan also available.
Teams starts USD9/seat/month billed annually (USD108/year); USD11 monthly. Additional invoices, projects, clients and tasks can incur usage charges; free plan available.

oss.name: Kimai
oss.classificationReason: AGPL-v3 self-hosted core; paid plugins add everyday expenses, task planning and custom fields. Core already provides time tracking, reports and invoicing. First-party Kimai Cloud verified separately.

health.rsx: Central rsx analyze succeeded: overall 6.4/10. License heuristic unknown; pinned license text used instead.

alternatives.migrationNotes: Official free importer plugin supports Toggl Track timesheet CSV; required columns and date formats must match. Reporting and invoicing available; expenses and task planning use paid plugins. Validate rates, currencies and timezones during migration.

Repository documents Toggl data import and project/task/client tracking with billable rates. Not full planning/integration parity; invoicing is excluded from Open Source. Validate imported data before switching.

Overlapping project timesheets, reporting and invoicing support a partial alternative. No Harvest-specific importer verified; CSV/JSON importer or API mapping required. Expense management requires paid plugin; accounting and payment integrations need separate assessment.

uncertainties: Only the two assigned candidates were fully verified in the focused research window.
No direct Harvest-specific importer verified; migration requires mapping exported records or using an API.
Root AGPL v3 license texts establish OSI core licensing; separate commercial plugins/extensions are outside this identification.
